newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Armed men shoot two dead in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Armed men shoot two dead in Manila.

text.p: Nine heavily armed men in a car with a fake number plate shot dead two people including a policeman in Manila's busiest thoroughfare on Wednesday and injured two others, a senior police officer said.
Traffic police chief Norberto Manaog said the suspects' car was flagged down by police while cruising along Epifanio de los Santos Avenue, on suspicion the registration plate was fake.
Manaog said the driver and eight passengers opened fire with armalite rifles on the three traffic policemen who inspected their car. One died on the spot while the two others were wounded.
The suspects, also armed with grenades, hijacked another car near the Makati commercial centre by shooting dead its owner.
Police said they have picked up two suspects for questioning.
